title: Control UI Without Stealing Focus -- 3-Tier Focusless Strategy
desc: UIA Invoke/Value/Toggle/Select = truly focusless. WM_CHAR = focusless typing via PostMessage. SendInput/Hotkey = must EnsureFocus first. Tier order: UIA pattern -> Win32 PostMessage -> SendInput. MFC CMaskEditEx: WM_CHAR only -- TranslateMessage auto-generates it, never use EM_SETTEXT or you get double input.
steps: Tier 1 (preferred, truly focusless): UIA Invoke / Value / Toggle / Select patterns — element pattern call, no message pump, no foreground change.

Tier 2 (focusless typing): Win32 PostMessage with WM_CHAR — bypasses focus-grab. Note for MFC CMaskEditEx, send WM_CHAR only; never EM_SETTEXT or you get double input because TranslateMessage already auto-generates WM_CHAR.
Tier 3 (last resort): SendInput / Hotkey — must call EnsureFocus first, so this path can steal focus from the user. Use only when patterns 1+2 unavailable.
author: claude
